business: Mendez Concrete & Pools (Mendez Concrete Works Solutions)
headline: Google sends people to your new site, but your Nextdoor page still points them to Instagram.
summary: Mendez Concrete & Pools is Fernando Mendez Garcia's concrete and pool contractor in Ramona, doing driveways, patios, sidewalks, stamped concrete, demolition and replacement, plus pool remodeling, plaster, waterline tile, coping, plumbing, and lighting. The license, #1089745 for C-8 Concrete and C53 Swimming Pool, shows as current and active on the CSLB site. Google Maps has a card for MENDEZ CONCRETE & POOLS, category Concrete contractor, with your phone, hours, photos, and your Google Site linked, and you answer neighbors' concrete requests on Nextdoor yourself. The main leftover is on Nextdoor: its website link still goes to an Instagram share link instead of the site your Google card uses. The other item is the name, which shows up a few different ways across your listings.

signals.note: Searching Mendez Concrete Works Solutions, Mendez Concrete Ramona, or (619) 540-1601 on Google Maps opens your card, MENDEZ CONCRETE & POOLS, listed as a Concrete contractor. The card links to your site and shows your phone and hours.
signals.next: Ask recent customers to leave a Google review that names the job, like a driveway or a pool replaster. Reply to each one; neighbors read the replies too.

signals.note: The card, your site, Nextdoor, and your CSLB record all show (619) 540-1601. Your site says call or text, and its call link dials that number.
signals.next: Keep that one number everywhere. If you take photo quotes by text, say so on the Google card description.

signals.note: When we checked, the card showed 7 AM to 5 PM, matching the 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM hours on Nextdoor, which lists Monday through Saturday and Sunday Closed. Your site does not list hours.
signals.next: Add a short hours line to your site so all three agree. Update Google first if you change hours for the season.

signals.note: The card has photos, and your Nextdoor page has a photo gallery. Your site has a Recent Projects section.
signals.next: Post a fresh before and after to the Google card after each big job. Finished stamped concrete and pool decks sell the next job.

signals.note: Your Google Site lists your concrete and pool services, your email, your phone, and your license number, and your Google card links to it. Your Nextdoor page links to instagram.com/mendez_concrete_works instead of this site.
signals.next: Swap the Nextdoor website link to https://sites.google.com/view/mendez-concrete-pools. Down the road, a short domain of your own would be easier to share than the Google Sites address.

signals.note: Your license is under Mendez Concrete Works Solutions, Google and your site say MENDEZ CONCRETE & POOLS, the Nextdoor page title is CONCRETE & POOLS, and Yelp says Mendez Concrete Works.
signals.next: Pick the name you want neighbors to search for and use it on Nextdoor, Yelp, and Google. Adding Mendez to the Nextdoor page title would help most.
